# Workspace instructions

This workspace contains a small Python weather application with command-line and Tkinter desktop interfaces. Keep the app dependency-light and beginner-friendly. Weather data is retrieved from Open-Meteo; no API key is needed. Preserve the mocked, network-free unittest suite when changing behavior.
